glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 辵 (“walk”) + 隹 (“short-tail bird”). A bird can only walk forward, not backward, hence implying "forward". Shuowen Jiezi interprets it as Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 辵 + abbreviated phonetic 閵.
s_page_origin: Simplified from 進 (隹 → 井) in the 1956 Chinese Character Simplification Scheme by the People's Republic of China. This character is not known to have existed before that. In simplified form, Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 辵 + phonetic 井.
shuowen: Shuowen Jiezi interprets it as Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 辵 + abbreviated phonetic 閵.
senses: [jìn] to enter; to go into; to come into
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 進; s_page_origin explains the simplified 进.
